title: Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 Anime Debuts in 2027
content:
The official website for the Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf anime revealed on Monday the second teaser visual and 2027 debut of the anime's second season .

Additional staff includes:

• Color Design: Tomoko Koyama

• Art Setting: Morihito Ōhara

• Art Director: Kazuhiro Inoue

• Director of Photography: Yuki Okada

• Editor: Ayako Tan

The anime's first season debuted in April 2024, and aired for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and also streamed an English dub .

The anime is a completely new series, which tells the story of Kraft Lawrence and his meeting with the wolf girl Holo. Jun Fukuyama returned as Kraft Lawrence, and Ami Koshimizu returned as Holo. Mai Nakahara also returned in the series as Norah Arendt.

Yen Press publishes the novels in English, and it describes the series:

The life of a traveling merchant is a lonely one, a fact with which Kraft Lawrence is well acquainted. Wandering from town to town with just his horse, cart, and whatever wares have come his way, the peddler has pretty well settled into his routine—that is, until the night Lawrence finds a wolf goddess asleep in his cart. Taking the form of a fetching girl with wolf ears and a tail, Holo has wearied of tending to harvests in the countryside and strikes up a bargain with the merchant to lend him the cunning of “Holo the Wisewolf” to increase his profits in exchange for taking her along on his travels. What kind of businessman could turn down such an offer? Lawrence soon learns, though, that having an ancient goddess as a traveling companion can be a bit of a mixed blessing. Will this wolf girl turn out to be too wild to tame?

Isuna Hasekura launched the Spice and Wolf novel series with illustrations by Jū Ayakura in 2006. The novels took a break after the 17th volume in 2011, and returned with the 18th volume in 2016. The 25th and latest volume will ship on October 9. Yen Press published the 24th novel in North America in August 2023, and is also publishing the manga adaptation. Hasekura began a spinoff series, Wolf & Parchment: New Theory Spice & Wolf , in April 2016. Yen Press is also releasing the spinoff series in English.

The novels also inspired two TV anime seasons from director Takeo Takahashi and scriptwriter Naruhisa Arakawa . The first season aired in Japan from January to March 2008, and the second season ( Spice and Wolf II ) from July to September 2009. Funimation released both seasons on home video.

A virtual reality anime followed the television anime and debuted in June 2019 for Oculus Rift, HTC VIVE, and Oculus Go Edition. A sequel debuted in December 2020.
author: ANN

title: FX Fighter Kurumi-chan TV Anime Reveals October 1 Debut in Main Promo Video
content:
Kadokawa revealed the main promotional video on Monday for the television anime of storywriter Demunyan and artist Daisuki Tansan 's FX Fighter Kurumi-chan ( FX Senshi Kurumi-chan ) manga. The company also revealed the anime will debut on October 1. Additionally, the company revealed Aina Suzuki as her character Kurumi Fukuga will perform the show's opening theme song "FX Senshi Kurumi-chan."

Kadokawa also revealed more staff members:

• Assistant Director: Shintarō Matsushima (Gyorai Eizo)

• Sub-Character Designer: Yūma Yokomatsu, Saki Fujita

• Art Director: Takaya Kobayashi (Kusanagi)

• Color Design: Tomoko Koyama (FINE COLORs)

• Director of Photography: Takashi Nakamichi

• Editing: Ayako Tan

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Sound Effects: Katsuhiro Nakajima

The anime will debut on AT-X on October 1 at 9:30 p.m., and on Tokyo MX at 10:30 p.m., before airing later that evening on BS11 and Kansai TV . The series will stream on d Anime Store first in Japan before other services.

The anime stars:

• Aina Suzuki as Kurumi Fukuga

• Asami Seto as Mochiko Kogane

• Ayasa Itō as Mebuki Yamashi

• Miho Okasaki as Yasuko Takane

Yūki Ogawa ( Ōya-san wa Shishunki! , Mieruko-chan , Miru Tights ) is directing the anime at Passione . Kenta Ihara ( Blue Miburo , Sentenced to Be a Hero ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Kazuyuki Ueda ( BanG Dream! (TV 2) , Love Flops , Hinako Note ) is the character designer, and Takurō Iga ( Oshi no Ko , Trillion Game ) is composing the music.

Suzuki will also perform the ending theme song "$・¥・€."

The manga centers on Kurumi Fukuka, a college student who will make her debut on the foreign exchange market in order to recover the 20 million yen (about US$126,000) her late mother lost in that market. She believes that it will be easy to get back that money, and with that goal in mind, she jumps into a world where things can turn from heaven to hell in an instant. Unrealized losses and loss-cutting, a racing heart that won't stop... Despite this, she wants to buy, sell, and earn. She is joined by other "FX fighters," and the market heats up. Kurumi continues to play a cute and slightly dangerous money game as charts swing back and forth. Can Kurumi and her friends survive in this raging world?

The duo launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Flapper magazine in February 2021. Kadokawa released the ninth volume in Japan on January 22. The 10th volume will ship on September 18.
author: ANN

title: Music Ray'n Suspends Activities of Voice Actress Moka Hinata, States She 'Engaged in Conduct That Damaged Trust'
content:
Talent agency Music Ray'n announced on Monday that it has suspended all activities of voice actress Moka Hinata until the end of December 2026, after it has confirmed that Hinata has engaged in conduct that has "severely damaged trust" with the parties involved. The company did not reveal details of the incident, but stated that actions that violate laws or regulations have not been identified in connection with the incident. Music Ray'n apologized to all parties concerned and to everyone who has supported Hinata and her vocal unit DayRe:. The company added that it will review its management system to prevent a similar incident from happening again, and put the utmost effort into regaining the trust that was lost.

Hinata apologized to fans and those involved on her on X (formerly Twitter ) account, and stated she will take time to reflect on herself in the hopes of being able to reunite with her fans one day.

Hinata voiced the character Mei Hayasaka in the 2021 anime Idoly Pride . She also voiced characters in several anime including Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included ; Classroom of the Elite 4th Season: Second Year, First Semester ; As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill ; I've Been Killing Slimes for 300 Years and Maxed Out My Level 2 ; and Stella of the Theater: World Dai Star .

The DayRe: vocal unit consists of Kanata Aikawa , Mirai Tachibana , Kokona Natsume , Hinata, and Koharu Miyazawa . The group was formed after passing the 3rd Music Ray'n Super Voice Actor Audition that was held in 2017.
author: ANN

title: Spice and Wolf Season 2 Reveals New Visual, 2027 Release Date
content:
Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF Season 2 revealed its second teaser visual, along with a 2027 release date. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season ended in September 2024. Studio Passione is animating the remake, which also included an arc that wasn’t in the original anime. The first season had Takeo Takahashi as the chief director, Hijiri Sanpei as the director, and character designs by Koji Haneda. You can see the new visual below.

The voice cast consists of:

• Ami Koshimizu as Holo

• Jun Fukuyama as Kraft Lawrence

• Mai Nakahara as Norah Arendt

• Saeko Chiba as Fermi Amati

• Hochu Otsuka as Marhait Liechten

• Aimi Tanaka as Myuuri

• Hozumi Goda as Hans Remerio

• Akeno Watanabe as Dian Rubens

• Shinpachi Tsuji as Jacob Tarantino

You can also see the previously revealed visual below.

The first Spice and Wolf anime was animated by studio Imagin and aired in the Winter 2008 anime season through 12 episodes. It received an OVA episode in May of the same year. A second OVA was released in May 2009, and a second 12-episode season by studios Marvy Jack and Brain’s Base aired in the summer of that year.

Isuna Haekura wrote the Spice and Wolf light novel series, which featured illustrations by Jyuu Ayakura. ASCII Media Works published it from 2006 to 2019, releasing a total of 22 volumes. A manga adaptation by Keito Koume ran from September 2007 to December 2017. A sequel novel titled Wolf and Parchment written by Hasekura and illustrated by Hidori is ongoing. Yen Press licensed both the original series and the sequel. Crunchyroll is streaming Spice and Wolf: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF . The story follows Kraft Lawrence, a traveling merchant who meets Holo the Wisewolf, a god who brings bountiful harvests. Together they embark on a journey, encountering all kinds of people and events.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Pokémon: Wild Card Anime Movie by Studio CloverWorks Announced for 2027
content:
A brand new Pokémon anime movie titled Pokémon: Wild Card has been announced for release in 2027. The film will center on the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG), with a teaser trailer and “Super Teaser Visual” revealed. It’s described as a completely original feature-length animated film.

The project was unveiled during the Pokémon World Championships 2026 in San Francisco and will mark the first new Pokémon movie in about seven years. The last theatrical release was Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle , which premiered in Japan in December 2020.

The teaser trailer introduces Mikiya, a Pokémon Card Game player wearing a yellow hood reminiscent of Mimikyu. Mimikyu itself also appears.

Katsuhiko Kitada, who previously worked as an episode director on THE FIRST SLAM DUNK , is directing the movie. Akemi Hayashi is handling character designs, with studio CloverWorks is in charge of animation production. You can see the teaser visual below.

Pokémon revealed its Generation 10 games and starters during this year’s Pokémon Day, presented during the Pokémon Presents livestream on February 27, 2026. The games are titled Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves and will release exclusively for the Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

The franchise previously revealed numerous special anime shorts, including an anime for World Earth Day , a Dragonite-focused short by CoMix Wave Films on Pokémon Day in 2025, and the recent POKÉTOON short anime titled Wartortle and the Continuation of Summer directed by Shingo Yamashita.

Another new anime, The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d & Pichu , was also recently announced for 2027. Animated by Aardma, the stop-motion anime will stream on Disney Plus.

title: 'The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune' TV Anime Reveals Promo Video, 2 Characters
content:
The staff of the television anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune ( Fuun kara no Saikyō Otoko ) light novel series revealed two characters and a promotional video on Monday.

Siegbert, a boy reincarnated into another world as a "lucky one" after a lifetime of misfortune.

Gert, Siegbert's older brother, gifted with exceptional natural talent.

The staff also revealed a new Abel Family illustration.

Shōya Chiba will star in the anime and also performs the anime's image song "Luck Out," featured in the above video. Chiba wrote the lyrics.

Shigetaka Ikeda ( Future Card Buddyfight ) is directing the anime. Aki Mizuki ( Sylvanian Families: Mini Story ) is in charge of series composition and the screenplay. Yumiko Hara ( Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun ) and Yūki Osada are designing the characters. East Fish Studio is in charge of animation production.

ASMIK Ace describes the anime:

Stand and fight – After a life defined by misfortune, Siegbert is reincarnated in another world as a “lucky one” blessed with extraordinary talent. Surrounded by a warm and loving family, he spends his days in happiness – until fate begins to shift. “I'll grow stronger, so I'll never lose anyone again.” So begins an isekai fantasy about a boy who will rise to become the strongest.

Fukufuku began serializing the story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in November 2020, where it is still ongoing. Starts Publishing released the first print volume of the story in March 2022, with illustrations by Zun Nakabayashi . The fourth novel volume shipped in March 2025.

Nakabayashi launched the manga adaptation of the novels in Starts Publishing 's Comic Glast online manga magazine on the publisher's Novemba website in October 2021. Starts Publishing released the manga's ninth compiled book volume on March 27. The franchise overall has over 1.75 million copies in circulation.

MangaPlaza is releasing the manga digitally in English under the title The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune .

title: Aniplex to Publish Fate/Extra Record Game; Kazuya Nino Leaves Type-Moon studio BB, Steps Down as Game's Director
content:
Aniplex announced on Monday that it will now publish Type-Moon studio BB's Fate/Extra Record game, the remake of Marvelous Entertainment 's Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game. Along with the announcement, Aniplex also launched a new website and X (formerly Twitter ) account for the game.

In addition, the game's director and planner, and Type-Moon studio BB director Kazuya Nino announced on Monday that he will be leaving Type-Moon studio BB, due to personal reasons, and has also stepped down as Fate/Extra Record game's director and planner. Nino added that he will be taking a break from developing games due to current health concerns. Nino was the producer for Fate/Extra , and also worked on the first Etrian Odyssey game.

The game has been delayed indefinitely following a mutual agreement between Notes (the Type-Moon creative circle's official corporate and publishing name) and Bandai Namco Entertainment for the latter to pull out of publishing of the game. Type-Moon noted then that development on the game will continue, but the game's development structure will change.

Type-Moon studio BB announced the game in July 2020, in what was the 10th anniversary of the original Fate/Extra game.

The game was slated for a release in spring this year after a previous delay from a 2025 release. The game is slated for the Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and PC via Steam . Aniplex 's announcement on Monday also revealed the game will also launch for Nintendo Switch 2.

Arco Wada returns as the game's character designer.

Marvelous Entertainment and Type-Moon released the Fate/Extra PlayStation Portable game in Japan in 2010. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2011. The Fate/Extra CCC companion game shipped in Japan on the PSP in March 2013. The games are set in an alternate science-fiction continuity of Type-Moon 's Fate universe, often referred to by fans as the "Extraverse."

The games inspired SHAFT 's 10-episode television anime Fate/Extra Last Encore in January 2018. Netflix began streaming the anime outside of Japan in June 2018. The three-episode Fate/Extra Last Encore: Illustrias Tendōsetsu (Illustrias Geocentrism) special then debuted in July 2018.

Marvelous released Fate/EXTELLA: The Umbral Star , a new "Extraverse" game, for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in November 2016. XSEED Games released the game in the West in January 2017, and on the PC and Switch in July 2017. Fate/EXTELLA LINK , an enhanced version of the game, shipped in Japan in June 2018, and XSEED Games released the game in March 2019.

Koei Tecmo launched the action RPG Fate/Samurai Remnant in September 2023. The game is available worldwide for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, PC via Steam , and Switch.

title: Pokémon: Wild Cards Reveal Is Teasing More Than an Animated Movie
content:
The Pokémon anime debuted in 1997 and has run for nearly three decades, arguably turning Ash Ketchum and Pikachu into a bigger entry point for new fans than the mainline video games themselves. The television success bred a parallel run of theatrical films, with more than twenty animated movies hitting screens between 1998 and 2020, several of which received wide releases in Japan and limited international runs through partners like Fathom Events. However, Pokémon has not put out a movie of any kind, animated or live-action, in seven years, an unusually long gap for a franchise that typically has some form of new content on the calendar every year. Now, with the brand marking its 30th anniversary in 2026, the pocket monsters are making a comeback to the big screen.

At the closing ceremony of the 2026 Pokémon World Championships in San Francisco, The Pokémon Company showed a teaser for Pokémon: Wild Card . The clip centers on a Pokémon Trading Card Game player dressed in a yellow hoodie that mirrors Mimikyu, the Ghost and Fairy type Pokémon known for disguising itself as a crude Pikachu. Mimikyu appears alongside the player throughout the teaser, being the only creature visible in the grey urban scenery where the movie apparently unfolds. Curiously, the trailer ends as the mysterious player looks at the screen, with the logo then revealing an unusual eye pattern. Katsuhiko Kitada, known for directing The First Slam Dunk and working on Attack on Titan and Naruto: Shippuden , is directing the film for animation studio CloverWorks, with a release set for 2027.

What Is Pokémon: Wild Card About?

The teaser’s brevity has left plenty of room for the community to speculate about Pokémon: Wild Card . Because Mimikyu is the only Pokémon glimpsed in the footage, some fans have floated the idea that the story unfolds outside the usual Pokémon world, with the trading card game acting as a link between our reality and theirs. Others have drawn a comparison to Yu-Gi-Oh! , wondering whether cards in Wild Card function as a summoning mechanic that conjures Pokémon into physical form. A third theory posits that the card player is Mimikyu itself, wearing a human disguise in search of a way back to its own world.

The teaser’s closing text, which says Pokémon: Wild Card is arriving in “2027 and beyond,” also points to something bigger than a single film. Wild Card could be the first chapter of a new animated series rather than a standalone movie, with the story built to continue past one installment. The Pokémon Company is also releasing Winds and Waves , the 10th generation of mainline Pokémon titles, for Switch 2 in 2027. Given the Switch 2’s success for the brand and the record-breaking sales of Pokémon Pokopia , perhaps the idea is to use the Pokémon: Wild Card setting for a new spinoff game. In any case, the upcoming movie is also tied closely to the profitable TCG. The Pokémon Company posted $3.3 billion in revenue for the fiscal year that ended in February 2026, its best year on record, with the trading card game producing roughly 10 billion cards in that same fiscal year and pushing its lifetime total past 85 billion cards since the trading card game launched in 1996. Centering the story on a TCG player marks a departure from the franchise’s usual movie formula, putting the card game itself at the center of the story for the first time. That can heat even more the TCG, with more people drawn into the game.

Pokémon: Wild Card is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

title: CloverWorks Produces New 'Pokemon: Wildcard' Movie for 2027
content:
The Pokemon Company announced a new anime film titled Pokemon: Wildcard during the Pokemon World Championships 2026 in San Francisco on Monday, revealing the main staff, announcement visual, and promotional video. The first new film in the Pokemon franchise in seven years is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Katsuhiko Kitada ( The First Slam Dunk episode director) is directing the film at CloverWorks . Akemi Hayashi ( Lazarus ) is designing the characters. STORY inc. is handling the planning and production.

The film will incorporate the Pokemon Trading Card Game with the Pokemon Mimikyu playing an important role.

The Pokemon franchise began to release movies in 1998 with Pokemon Movie 01: Mewtwo no Gyakushuu ( Pokémon: The First Movie - Mewtwo Strikes Back ), while its latest movie, Pokemon Movie 23: Koko ( Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle ) premiered in December 2020. The most recent television anime Pokemon (2023) ( Pokémon Horizons: The Series ) premiered in April 2023.

title: Ikkado Ito's The Long Summer of August 31 Manga Gets TV Anime, Live-Action Series Adaptations
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Ikkado Ito 's The Long Summer of August 31 ( August 31 no Long Summer ) manga announced on Monday that it is getting a television anime by SHAFT , and a live-action series adaptation. The account also revealed the anime adaptation's ultra teaser visual.

Ito also drew an illustration to announce the adaptations:

Seven Seas Entertainment and Kodansha 's K MANGA service publish the manga physically and digitally, respectively. Seven Seas describes the story:

Caught in an endlessly repeating August 31st, high schoolers Suzuki Takaya and Takagi Kana are the only ones who remember each loop. The likely cause? Suzuki's unfinished summer mission to secure a girlfriend and lose his virginity—the ultimate teenage goal. A hilarious yet heartfelt time-loop comedy!

Ito launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in 2023. Kodansha published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on August 21. Seven Seas published the manga's sixth volume physically on August 25.

Ito launched the I'm Not Meat: Get Your Filthy Paws Off Me! ( Boku wa Oniku janai ) manga in Shogakukan 's Monthly Spirits magazine in July 2020. Shogakukan published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in December 2021. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga under its Ghost Ship imprint, and published the manga's third and final volume in English in May 2023.
